title: Followed by a 12-year-old tall white girl on the walk back to the Nellis barracks

tellings.quote: following me was the tall white girl that the 12-year-old

plain: A former airman named Charles Hall says that in 1965, while walking back to his barracks at Nellis Air Force Base in Nevada, he was followed by a young girl, about 12 years old, from the beings he calls the "tall whites." Hall tells this as his own experience, part of his account of spending three years in contact with tall, pale beings at the base. If true, it would mean these beings moved around freely near the people stationed there.
